name: 2023 04 12 April Special PC Agenda
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  SPECIAL PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
April 12, 2023 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Judy Lee for
  Special Use Permit No. 2022-011 (SP-2022-011) to allow:
  1) The construction of a new self-storage facility; and
  2) A reduced parking requirement through alternate modes of
  transportation on an M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned
  property at 3846 West Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice of
  Exemption EA-CE-2022-146; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt Findings and the
  attached resolution approving SP-2022-011 subject to 12
  conditions.
  Item 5a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Winston Liu for a
  Zoning Code Amendment to allow Automated Car Wash Facilities in
  the MU-C (Mixed-Use Corridor) zone as standalone uses (not
  ancillary to a service station)
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice of
  Exemption EA-CE-2023-013; and
  b. Adopt a Resolution Recommending approval of Zoning Code
  Amendment No. 23-00001.
  Item 5b Documents

6.  NON-PUBLIC HEARING
  a. Design  Review  2022-014  (DR-2022-014)  to  allow  on  an
  approximately 72,000 square-foot, M-1L (Limited Manufacturing)
  zoned property at 3846 West Century Boulevard.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2022-146
  b. Adopt the attached resolution approving DR-2022-014
  subject to 8 conditions and/or add conditions as deemed
  appropriate.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  Commission Initiatives

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Adjournment.
 If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations must be
received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of April 12, 2023, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 3, 2023, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
